name: authenticator-setup
title: Authenticator setup
description: Two-step sign-in setup in one card: scan the QR code or type the key, then confirm with the first six-digit code. It works without a camera.
docs: The block draws no QR code: pass your own SVG or image in qr (draw it from the otpauth address with a QR library). It is wrapped with alt text that carries the key, so setup works without a camera, and it sits on a white tile, so keep it dark on light. onVerify resolves true or false; a wrong code is announced and cleared. After success the card shows what you pass as next, usually a button to the recovery codes, and the focus moves to that confirmation so the button is one Tab away. title, description and headingLevel (2 or 3) rename the heading and set its level.
